deep_dive.title: Deep Thought Alignment: Trajectory-Level Latent Distillation for Video Reasoning
deep_dive.abstract: Large Multimodal Models (LMMs) for video reasoning have long been hindered by the high computational cost of processing vast amounts of visual information. This dilemma motivates the transfer of the reasoning capabilities of large models to smaller, more efficient ones. On-Policy Distillation (OPD) offers a promising solution by matching output-token distributions along student-generated trajectories. However, video reasoning often depends on evidence accumulated across multiple frames. In this context, output-level supervision only captures information expressed through token predictions and does not directly constrain the latent representations formed during reasoning. To address this limitation, we propose Latent-OPD, which augments OPD with trajectory-level latent distillation. Specifically, our method focuses on the position at the end of each trajectory, where hidden states effectively summarize the accumulated visual evidence and reasoning context. Furthermore, we introduce a progressive teacher-lookahead strategy, which aligns middle-to-late student layers with increasingly deeper teacher layers. Experiments on six video reasoning benchmarks show that Latent-OPD consistently outperforms output-only OPD. Notably, the improvements are particularly pronounced in scenarios with limited frames, long videos, or tasks requiring complex evidence aggregation. These results establish Latent-OPD as a highly effective approach to frame-efficient video reasoning.

deep_dive.llm_tldr_en: Augments on-policy distillation to constrain latent reasoning representations for video understanding, transferring large model reasoning to smaller models more efficiently.
deep_dive.llm_tldr_cn: 论文针对视频推理中大规模多模态模型计算成本高的问题，提出Latent-OPD方法。该方法在on-policy蒸馏匹配输出token分布的基础上，进一步约束推理过程中的潜在表示，以弥补输出级监督无法直接刻画多帧累积证据的不足。实验表明Latent-OPD能更有效地将大模型推理能力迁移到小模型，缓解了视频推理中的高效蒸馏难题。
